```{r setup, results = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

## libraries ----

library(here)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mfutils)
library(ggseg)
library(ggsegExtra)
library(ggsegSchaefer)
library(ggsegGlasser)
library(brms)
library(broom)
library(colorspace)

source(here("src", "stroop-rsa-pc.R"))

## settings, params ----

opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, out.width = "100%")
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 18))

theme_surface <- list(
  theme(
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.5, -0.05),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.height = unit(1/3, "cm"), legend.key.width = unit(2/3, "cm"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
)
theme_basic <- list(
  theme(
    #axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
    panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )
)

colors_model <- c(
  target = "#1b9e77",
  incongruency = "#d95f02",
  distractor = "#7570b3"
)

colors_session <- c(
  baseline = "#1f78b4",
  proactive = "#b2df8a",
  reactive = "#a6cee3"
)


## constants ----

models <- c("incongruency", "distractor", "target")
subjlists <- combo_paste(sessions, "_", waves)
seswaves <- subjlists
glmname <- "lsall_1rpm"
measure <- "crcor"
prewh <- "none"
ttype_subsets <- c("pc50", "bias")
roisets <- c("glasser2016_parcel")


## data ----

## read regression weights:

d_rsa <- enlist(combo_paste(roisets, ttype_subsets, subjlists))
for (roiset in roisets) {
  for (ttype_subset in ttype_subsets) {
    for (subjlist in subjlists) {
      fname <- construct_filename_weights(
          ttype_subset = ttype_subset,
          measure = measure, 
          subjlist = subjlist,
          glmname = glmname, 
          roiset = roiset,
          prewh = prewh, 
          suffix = paste0("__seswave-", subjlist),
          base_dir = here("out", "weights")
          )

      d <- fread(fname)
      d$ttype_subset <- ttype_subset
      d$roiset <- roiset
      d_rsa[[paste0(roiset, ttype_subset, subjlist)]] <- d
    }
  }
}
d_rsa <- rbindlist(d_rsa)

## read decoding results

fname <-
  "trainbaseline__wave1__svm__glasser2016__parcel__nresamp100__lsall_1rpm__divnormed__demeaned__centered_summarized.RDS"
path_data <- here("out", "decoding")
subjdirs <- list.dirs(path_data)[-1]
does_exist <- file.exists(file.path(subjdirs, fname))
subjdirs <- subjdirs[does_exist]
l <- parallel::mclapply(subjdirs, function(x) readRDS(file.path(x, fname)), mc.cores = 20)
d_dec <- rbindlist(l)
d_dec <- d_dec[train_stimset %in% ttype_subsets]
## add behavior:
beh <- fread(here("in", "behavior-and-events_stroop_2022-05-27_nice.csv"))
beh <- beh %>%
  group_by(subj, session, wave, run) %>%
  mutate(trial = trial_num + ifelse(session %in% c("baseline", "proactive"), 108, 120) * (run - 1)) %>%
  select(wave, session, run, trial, subj, time_target_onset, rt, acc)
d_dec <- data.table::merge.data.table(d_dec, beh, by = c("subj", "session", "wave", "trial"), all.x = TRUE)
## add test_stimset:
d_dec[, test_stimset := ""]
d_dec[stimulus %in% ttypes$bias, test_stimset := "bias"]
d_dec[stimulus %in% ttypes$pc50, test_stimset := "pc50"]


## configure atlas:

atlas <- glasser
atlas$data <- atlas$data %>% filter(region != "H")  ## remove HC from atlas, b/c not in data!
k <- glasser2016_fsaverage5$key %>% 
  select(region = parcel, network) %>%
  mutate(region = gsub("L_|R_", "", region))

d_dec[, region := gsub("L_|R_", "", roi)]
d_dec[, hemi := ifelse(grepl("L_", roi), "left", "right")]
d_dec <- d_dec[!(region %in% c("10pp") & hemi == "left")]  ## not in glasser ggseg atlas?
d_dec[, region_hemi := paste0(toupper(substr(hemi, 1, 1)), "_", region)]
d_dec[, network := k$network[match(region, k$region)]]

d_rsa[, region := gsub("L_|R_", "", roi)]
d_rsa[, hemi := ifelse(grepl("L_", roi), "left", "right")]
d_rsa <- d_rsa[!(region %in% c("10pp") & hemi == "left")]  ## not in glasser ggseg atlas?
d_rsa[, region_hemi := paste0(toupper(substr(hemi, 1, 1)), "_", region)]
d_rsa[, network := k$network[match(region, k$region)]]


## subject lists
stopifnot(setdiff(d_dec$subj, d_rsa$subject) == character(0))

subjs_table <- as.data.table(table(d_rsa$subject, d_rsa$wave, d_rsa$session) > 0)
names(subjs_table) <- c("subj", "wave", "session", "has_data")
subjs_wave1 <-
  subjs_table %>%
  filter(wave == "wave1") %>%
  group_by(subj) %>%
  summarize(alldat = sum(has_data) == 3) %>%
  filter(alldat) %>%
  pull(subj)
subjs_wave2 <- subjs_table %>%
  group_by(subj) %>%
  summarize(alldat = sum(has_data) == 6) %>%
  filter(alldat) %>%
  pull(subj)

rois_language <- k %>% filter(network == "Language") %>% pull(region)
rois_vis <- c("V1", "V2", "V3", "V4")

```



# within-session RSA

```{r}

d_sum_rsa <-
  d_rsa %>%
  filter(subject %in% subjs_wave1, session %in% c("baseline", "proactive"), wave == "wave1", term %in% models) %>%
  group_by(subject, wave, term, ttype_subset, region, hemi, region_hemi) %>%
  summarize(b = mean(b)) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, region, hemi, region_hemi) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup


d_sum_rsa %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_brain(
    aes(fill = ifelse(p_fdr < 0.05, t_stat, NA)),
    atlas = atlas,
    position = position_brain(. ~ side + hemi)
    ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma", na.value = "grey",
    breaks = scales::extended_breaks(4)
    ) +
  theme_surface +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(term),
    cols = vars(ttype_subset),
    labeller =
      labeller(
        ttype_subset = c(bias = "biased stimuli", pc50 = "unbiased stimuli"),
        term = c(target = "targ", distractor = "distr", incongruency = "incon")
      )
    ) +
  labs(fill = expression("t | p"[FDR]<0.05)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top"))
ggsave(here("out", "ohbm", "maineffects.pdf"), height = 1*3, width = 3*3, dev = "pdf")



d_sum_rsa %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("term", "region_hemi"), names_from = "ttype_subset", values_from = "t_stat") %>%
  ggplot(aes(bias, pc50)) +
  geom_abline() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(vars(term), scales = "free")

d_sum_rsa %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("term", "region_hemi"), names_from = "ttype_subset", values_from = "t_stat") %>%
  mutate(contr = pc50 - bias) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  slice_max(abs(contr), n = 10)


## contrast


dat_con_rsa <-
  d_rsa %>%
  filter(subject %in% subjs_wave1, session %in% c("baseline", "proactive"), wave == "wave1", term %in% models) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("region_hemi", "network", "subject", "wave", "term", "ttype_subset", "roiset", "region", "hemi"),
    names_from = "session",
    values_from = "b"
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, region, hemi, region_hemi) %>%
  mutate(b = baseline - proactive) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b)$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  ) %>%
  left_join(select(d_sum_rsa, wave, term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, p_fdr)) %>%
  mutate(is_sig = p_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset, is_sig) %>%
  mutate(p_contr_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"), p_contr_fdr = ifelse(is_sig, p_contr_fdr, NA)) %>%
  ungroup


dat_con_rsa %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_brain(
    #aes(fill = ifelse(abs(t_stat) > 2, t_stat, NA)),
    aes(
      fill = ifelse(
        (ttype_subset == "bias" & p_contr_fdr < 0.05) | (ttype_subset == "pc50" & is_sig),
        t_stat, NA
        )
      ),
    atlas = atlas,
    position = position_brain(. ~ side + hemi)
    ) +
  scale_fill_continuous_diverging(palette = "BlueRed3") +
  theme_surface +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(term), cols = vars(ttype_subset),
    labeller =
      labeller(
        ttype_subset = c(bias = "biased stimuli", pc50 = "unbiased stimuli (unthresholded)"),
        term = c(target = "targ", distractor = "distr", incongruency = "incon")
      )
    ) +
  labs(fill = expression("t | p"[FDR]<0.05)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top"))

ggsave(here("out", "ohbm", "contrast_rsa.pdf"), height = 1*3, width = 3*3, dev = "pdf")
```

# cross-session decoding


```{r}

## per session

d_dec_subj <- d_dec[
  ,
  list(
    t_stat = t.test(evidence)$statistic,
    p = t.test(evidence, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(evidence)
  ),
  by = c(
    "subj", "session", "wave", "variable", "train_stimset", "test_stimset", "region", "hemi", "region_hemi", "network"
    )
]

d_dec_subj  <- d_dec_subj %>%
  filter(train_stimset == test_stimset) %>%
  select(
    subject = subj, session, wave, term = variable, ttype_subset = train_stimset, region, hemi,
    region_hemi, network, t_stat, p, b
    ) %>%
  mutate(term = ifelse(term == "congruency", "incongruency", term))

d_sum_dec <-
  d_dec_subj %>%
  filter(subject %in% subjs_wave1, session %in% c("reactive", "proactive"), wave == "wave1", term %in% models) %>%
  #mutate(ttype_subset = "biased + unbiased") %>%
  group_by(subject, wave, term, ttype_subset, region, hemi, region_hemi) %>%
  summarize(b = mean(b)) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, region, hemi, region_hemi) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup


d_sum_dec %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_brain(
    aes(fill = ifelse(p_fdr < 0.05, t_stat, NA)),
    atlas = atlas,
    position = position_brain(. ~ side + hemi)
    ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma", na.value = "grey",
    breaks = scales::extended_breaks(4)
    ) +
  theme_surface +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(term),
    cols = vars(ttype_subset),
    labeller =
      labeller(
        ttype_subset = c(bias = "biased stimuli", pc50 = "unbiased stimuli"),
        term = c(target = "targ", distractor = "distr", incongruency = "incon")
      )
    ) +
  labs(fill = expression("t | p"[FDR]<0.05)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top"))

ggsave(here("out", "ohbm", "maineffects_dec.pdf"), height = 3, width = 9, dev = "pdf")

## contrast

dat_con_dec <-
  d_dec_subj %>%
  filter(subject %in% subjs_wave1, session %in% c("reactive", "proactive"), wave == "wave1", term %in% models) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("region_hemi", "network", "subject", "wave", "term", "ttype_subset", "region", "hemi"),
    names_from = "session",
    values_from = "b"
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, region, hemi, region_hemi) %>%
  #mutate(b = baseline/sd(baseline) - proactive/sd(proactive)) %>%
  mutate(b = reactive - proactive) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b)$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  ) %>%
  left_join(select(d_sum_dec, wave, term, region_hemi, p_fdr)) %>%

      )
    ) +
  labs(fill = expression("t | p"[FDR]<0.05)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top")) +
```

```{r}
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("subject", "term", "ttype_subset", "region_hemi"),
    names_from = "session",
    values_from = "b"
  ) %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset, region_hemi) %>%
  mutate(b = reactive - proactive) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b)$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  ) %>%
  left_join(select(d_sum_dec_md, term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, p_fdr)) %>%
  mutate(is_sig = p_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset, is_sig) %>%
  mutate(p_contr_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"), p_contr_fdr = ifelse(is_sig, p_contr_fdr, 1))

d_dec_md %>%
  filter(region_hemi %in% c("L_IFJp", "L_8C")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(term, b)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_boot, aes(color = session), geom = "errorbar", width = 1/8, size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, aes(color = session), geom = "point", size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, aes(color = session, group = session), geom = "line") +
  geom_text(
    data =
      dat_con_dec_md %>% filter(ttype_subset == "pc50", region_hemi %in% c("L_IFJp", "L_8C")) %>% 
      select(term, ttype_subset, region_hemi, p_contr_fdr),
    aes(y = Inf, label = ifelse(p_contr_fdr < 0.05, "*", "")),
    hjust = 1,
    size = 8
  ) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(region_hemi), scales = "free_x") +
  theme_basic +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.line.y = element_line()) +
  labs(y = "Mean discriminability (a.u.)", x = NULL)


### visual

d_dec_vis <-  d_dec_subj %>%
  filter(
    subject %in% subjs_wave1, session %in% c("reactive", "proactive"), wave == "wave1", term %in% models,
    region %in% rois_vis
    ) %>%
  mutate(region = "V1-V4") %>%
  group_by(subject, session, wave, term, ttype_subset, region) %>%
  summarize(b = mean(b))

d_sum_dec_vis <-
  d_dec_vis %>%
  group_by(subject, wave, term, ttype_subset, region) %>%  ## average over session
  summarize(b = mean(b)) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset, region) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  ) %>%
  group_by(wave, term, ttype_subset) %>%
  mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr")) %>%
  ungroup

dat_con_dec_vis <-
  d_dec_vis %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("subject", "term", "ttype_subset", "region"),
    names_from = "session",
    values_from = "b"
  ) %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset, region) %>%
  mutate(b = reactive - proactive) %>%
  summarize(
    t_stat = t.test(b)$statistic,
    p = t.test(b)$p.value,
    b = mean(b)
  ) %>%
  left_join(select(d_sum_dec_vis, term, ttype_subset, region, p_fdr)) %>%
  mutate(is_sig = p_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(term, ttype_subset, is_sig) %>%
  mutate(p_contr_fdr = p.adjust(p, "fdr"), p_contr_fdr = ifelse(is_sig, p_contr_fdr, NA))

d_dec_md1 <- d_dec_md %>% 
  filter(ttype_subset == "pc50", region_hemi %in% c("L_IFJp", "L_8C")) %>%
  select(subject, session, wave, term, ttype_subset, region = region_hemi, b)

d4plot <- d_dec_vis %>%
  full_join(d_dec_md1 %>% select(subject, session, wave, term, ttype_subset, region, b) %>% filter(ttype_subset == "pc50"))

d4plot %>%
  mutate(term = substr(term, 1, 5), term = ifelse(term == "targe", "targ", term)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(term, b)) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot, aes(color = session), geom = "errorbar", width = 1/4, size = 1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)
    ) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, aes(color = session), geom = "point", size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  #stat_summary(fun = mean, aes(color = session, group = session), geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(region), scales = "free_x") +
  theme_basic +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.line.x = element_line(size = 0.5), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(y = "Mean discriminability (a.u.)", x = NULL) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_session) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 3)

ggsave(here("out", "ohbm", "rois_dec.pdf"), height = 2.75, width = 5, dev = "pdf")
```
